# GFM Table

Below is a standard GFM table:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| foo  | str  | ""      | A string value |
| bar  | num  | 0       | A numeric value |
| baz  | bool | false   | A boolean flag |

| Item | Price | Stock |
|-----:|------:|------:|
| Apple | $1.20 | 100 |
| Banana | $0.50 | 250 |
| Cherry | $3.00 | 50 |

End of tables.
